subject.title: feat(browser): add secure per-tab copilot panel

question: Should browser-copilot clients be prohibited from broad session subscriptions, or should Gateway extend the authoritative session-key allowlist to every transcript and tool-event delivery path?
rationale: Both choices can preserve the intended panel behavior, but they establish the permanent Gateway contract for scoped clients and require owner judgment beyond a localized code repair.

options.title: Fail closed on broad subscriptions
options.body: Reject broad `sessions.subscribe` access for browser-copilot clients and retain only explicitly authorized per-session subscriptions.

options.title: Generalize scoped delivery
options.body: Extend authoritative session-key propagation and filtering to every transcript and tool-event broadcast path before allowing broad subscription APIs.

recommendation.title: Fail closed on broad subscriptions
recommendation.body: Reject broad `sessions.subscribe` access for browser-copilot clients and retain only explicitly authorized per-session subscriptions.

likelyOwner.reason: The earlier per-tab copilot proposal is the stated product-direction basis for this security-contract rebuild.
